In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
